q: Who Introduced The Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Amendment Bill, 2026?
exp: Introduced By: Dr. Jitendra Singh, Minister Of Personnel, Public Grievances & Pensions. Amended - 2024 Act. Main Aim: To Make Strong - Legal Framework Against Paper Leaks (NEET, UPSC, SSC...). Imprisonment: 5-10 Years. Fine: 50 Lakh To 10 Crore.

q: Jan Vishwas (Amendment) Bill, 2026 Is Related To What?
exp: Jan Vishwas (Amendment of Provisions) Bill, 2026. Passed by: Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha. Amendment - 784 Provisions of 79 Central Acts Amended. Aim: To Decriminalise Minor Offences {Removing Criminal Punishment (Jail) For Small/Minor Violations}.

q: Prevention Of Insults To National Honour (Amendment) Bill, 2026 Provides Legal Protection To Which Of The Following ?
exp: The Bill Amended - Prevention Of Insults To National Honour Act, 1971. Under This Bill: If Intentional Insult To Vande Mataram - Jail Up To 3 Years. Vande Mataram: National Song {By - Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay}. Vande Mataram Taken From Anandmath Novel: Based On Sannyasi Rebellion. National Anthem: Jana Gana Mana {Rabindranath Tagore}.

q: Which Regulatory Body Gets Statutory Status Under The SHANTI Bill, 2025?
o: Nuclear Power Corp of India Ltd
exp: SHANTI Bill, 2025: Recently Passed By Parliament. SHANTI - Sustainable Harnessing and Advancement of Nuclear Energy for Transforming India. This Bill allows limited private companies to work in the nuclear sector. IND’s Targets Of - 100 GW nuclear power by 2047. Given Statutory Status To - AERB (Directly answerable to Parliament).

q: The Sabka Bima Sabki Raksha Bill, Passed By Lok Sabha, Seeks To Raise The FDI Limit In Insurance Sector To?
exp: Sabka Bima, Sabki Raksha (Amendment of Insurance Laws) Bill, 2025. Amendments: Insurance Act, 1938, the Life Insurance Corporation Act, 1956, and IRDA Act, 1999. Key Provision: Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) limit in Indian insurance companies Increased from - 74% to 100%. Vision: Insurance for All by 2047.

q: After The Proposed Amendment, What Will Be The Total Strength Of The Supreme Court Including The Chief Justice Of India?
exp:
Union Cabinet Chaired By PM Narendra Modi Approved - Supreme Court (Number Of Judges) Amendment Bill, 2026. Will Amend - Supreme Court (Number Of Judges) Act, 1956. Number Of Judges Will Increase From - 33 To

37. Total Strength Will Be: 38 (Including CJI). Appointment Of SC Judges: By President of India. Article 124: Establishment & Constitution of SC.

q: The Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code Was Originally Enacted In Which Year?
exp: Recently Parliament Passed - Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code (Amendment) Bill, 2026. Amended - Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016. Focus On: Faster Resolution + Stronger Framework. Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016. Based on recommendations Of: T.K. Vishwanathan’s - Bankruptcy Law Reforms Committee (2015). Regulating Body: Insolvency and Bankruptcy Board of India (IBBI).

q: Under CAPF Act 2026, What Percentage Of DG Posts Are Reserved For IPS Officers?
exp: Central Armed Police Forces (General Administration) Act, 2026. This Act Mandates: IPS Officers Reservation In - Top Leadership In All Five CAPFs - BSF, CRPF, CISF, ITBP, SSB. IG (Inspector General) Post Reservation For IPS - 50%. Additional Director General: At least 67%. Special DG and Director General (DG) - 100% Post Reserved For IPS.

q: Which Bill Was Passed By Lok Sabha In 2026 For Transgender Rights?
o: Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Amendment Bill, 2026
exp: Bill Amended - Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Act, 2019. Key Amendment: Removed - Self-identification of gender (Which Was Recognized by - NALSA Case 2014). Now Identity Depends On - Medical Verification Process (Medical Certification). Related Articles: Article 14: Equality Before Law. Article 21: Right To Life & Dignity.

q: The Railways (Amendment) Bill, 2024, merges which act into the Railways Act, 1989?
exp: Railways (Amendment) Bill, 2024: Passed In Loksabha. It Provides: Central Govt to decide the: Composition of the Railway Board {Including: Number of members, their terms of service, and their qualifications}. Railway Minister: Ashwini Vaishnaw.

q: Which Of The Following Is Banned Under The Promotion And Regulation Of Online Gaming Bill, 2025?
exp: Promotion And Regulation Of Online Gaming Bill, 2025. Came Into Force On - 1st May, 2026. Objective - To regulate online gaming & To promote e-sports & educational games. Ban - Online money games like poker, rummy, fantasy sports (Dream 11). Penalties - Up to 3 years jail & ₹1 crore fine for money games.

q: The Constitution (130th) Bill, 2025 Provides For Removal Of PM, CMs, Ministers Detained For How Many Consecutive Days?
exp: Constitution (One Hundred And Thirtieth Amendment) Bill, 2025. Introduced By - Union Home And Cooperation Minister Amit Shahh. Under This Bill: PM, CMs or Ministers - Must Be Resigned Or Be Removed - If They Remain In Custody For 30 Consecutive Days. Articles Amended - 75 (PM), 164 (CMs), 239AA (Delhi).

q: When Did The Banking Laws (Amendment) Act, 2025 Come Into Effect?
exp: Total 19 Amendments In 5 Major Laws - Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934; Banking Regulation Act, 1949; State Bank of India Act, 1955; and the Banking Companies (Acquisition and Transfer of Undertakings) Acts of 1970 and 1980. Tenure of directors In cooperative banks: Increased From 8 Yrs To 10 Yrs. Substantial interest’ for Directors: Increased From 5 Lakhs To 2 Cr.

q: Which Act has been amended by the Waqf (Amendment) Act, 2025?
exp: The Waqf (Amendment) Bill, 2024. Introduced in Lok Sabha on: 8 August 2024. Introduced By: Minority Affairs Minister » Kiren Rijiju. Passed By Parliament (April 2025) - After President’s Assent - Became An Act.

q: Financial Bills are governed under which Article of the Constitution?
exp: Recently Lok Sabha Passed: Finance Bill 2025. Key Highlights: 6% digital tax on online ads: Abolished. Total expenditure (2025-26): ₹50.65 lakh crore. Capital Expenditure: Proposed - ₹11.22 lakh Cr. Govt’s aims to collect: ₹42.70 lakh Cr: from Taxes. Estimated borrowing: ₹14.01 lakh crore. Fiscal Deficit Target: 4.4% Of GDP. GDP Estimated FY 2025-26: 3,569.79 Lakh Cr.

q: The Oilfields (Regulation And Development) Amendment Bill, 2024 Will Amend Which Act?
exp: Introduced by: Ministry Of Petroleum and Natural Gas. Aim: To modernize the legal framework for Oil And Gas Exploration and production in India.

q: What is the maximum imprisonment under the Immigration and Foreigners Bill, 2025, for violations like overstaying visas?
exp: Immigration and Foreigners Bill, 2025. Aim: To Regulate The Entry, Stay, And Exit Of Foreign Nationals In India. Introduced In Parliament: By Minister of State for Home Affairs: Nityanand Rai. This Bill Purposes To Repeal: The Passport (Entry into India) Act, 1920; The Registration of Foreigners Act, 1939; The Foreigners Act, 1946; The Immigration (Carriers’ Liability) Act, 2000.

q: Union Cabinet approved the new Income Tax Bill to replace which act?
exp: Union Cabinet (Chaired By - PM Modi) Approved: new Income Tax Bill 2025. Will replace: 6 Decade Old » Income Tax Act, 1961. New Bill’s Aim: To simplify, modernize, and streamline India’s tax system.

q: Who Resigned From The Post Of Vice President Of India On 21st July 2025 Due To Health Reasons?
exp: Jagdeep Dhankhar: Was 14th Vice-President Of India. Vice President Of India: Article 63: Post of Vice-President. Article 64: VP shall be ex-officio Chairman of the Council of States (Rajya Sabha). Art 66: Election. Art 67: Term (5 Years). Article 67(a) - Resignation Process of the Vice President.

q: Who Issued A Suo Moto Directive To Remove Stray Dogs In The National Capital Region (NCR)?
exp: Suo Moto: Meaning - “On its own motion.” It allows courts to begin legal proceedings by themselves, without anyone complaining. Constitutional Provisions: Article 21: Right To Life (Protects human life and safety). Article 51A(g) - Fundamental Duty Of citizens - to show compassion (संिेदना) for all living creatures. Article 32: Gives SC Authority - To Protect Fundamental Rights.

q: Who will now manage the licensing process for aviation personnel (विमानन कालमगक) as per the Bharatiya Vayuyan Vidheyak Bill?
exp: Bharatiya Vayuyan Vidheyak Bill 2024: Recently Passed By Parliament. It Replaced: Aircraft Act, 1934. Under This Bill: Now Licencing Process For Aviation Personnel: Will Be Managed By: Directorate General of Civil Aviation. Before: Department of Telecom.
